About CT Electrical Sales

Technical experience. Local relationships. Better electrical solutions.

We represent specialized electrical manufacturers and help distributors, contractors, engineers, OEMs and facility teams move from application questions to practical answers.

Our story

Representation grounded in how electrical systems work.

CT Electrical Sales brings together more than 20 years of experience across electrical distribution, power quality, energy management, technical sales and field applications.

We built the company around a straightforward idea: customers deserve more than a catalog link, and manufacturers deserve more than passive coverage. Our role is to understand the application, connect the right people and stay involved as the opportunity moves forward.

From breakers, transformers and conductors to switchboards, UPS systems, metering and power monitoring, we help customers see how individual products fit into the larger electrical system.

How we work

Commercial responsiveness backed by technical depth.

Our approach is built for customers who need useful answers and manufacturers who expect active market development.

01

Start with the application

We listen for the operating need, specification, constraint and timeline before recommending a product path.

02

Connect the full channel

We work with distributors, contractors, engineers, OEMs, EOEMs and end users to keep projects moving.

03

Stay technically engaged

We support product selection, education, demonstrations and coordination with the manufacturer’s specialists.
